title: Headless Agatha's Song (MS17, TTW 3.4): from Agatha's request to the Soil Stradivarius given back to her (stage 100)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10) [observed: MQ01 stage 10 shows its first objective]. MS17 is Start Game Enabled and runs from the start [observed]; nothing else of the main quest is needed for it.

Path (Agatha's side): Agatha's first greeting; the polite talk through her lost violin to her request (MS17AgathaCTQuestAccept: QuestInProgress); the story and her advice to try Vault-Tec Headquarters (MS17AgathaCTVault9201, stage 10); at Vault-Tec HQ the three System Operation Stations approve mainframe access (MFLock01-03 unlock the mainframe room door) and the mainframe's download shows the vaults' map markers (stage 30); in Vault 92 (VaultArrival) the Soil Stradivarius case is taken (its OnAdd sets 50); Agatha is shown it (MS17TLStradStatus: stage 100, Complete). The other ending, the violin sold to Abraham Washington or Ahzrukhal (150), is not played. [observed: MS17 stage, INFO and object scripts on the TTW load order]
Stand-in for the walk to Vault-Tec Headquarters in the D.C. ruins (the optional objective 20); inside, the quest script sees the player in VaultTecHQ01 (FoundVT, VaultTec) and shows objective 30.

The three System Operation Stations each approve mainframe access (entry 1, MFLock01-03); with all three the quest script unlocks MS17MainframeAccessDoor. The robots and turrets on the way are the pilot's fight.
The mainframe asks whether to download its data (MS17MainframeMessage); the first button sets 30, shows Vault 92's map marker and gives the vault locations note.
Stand-in for the walk to Vault 92: inside, the quest script sees the player there (VaultArrival) and completes the optional objectives.
The Soil Stradivarius' case is taken: its OnAdd (MS17SoilStradCaseScript) sets 50 while Agatha lives.

The case is in the recording studio, whose door (doorVault92RecordingStudio, lock level 255, no key) only the Studio Computer opens: its item 1, Open Recording Studio, unlocks it (TERM MS17Vault92ProducerTerminal, Fallout3.esm); without it the pilot found no way to the case (sweep 2 [observed]).
Stand-in for the walk back to Agatha's house. Her greeting for a player back with the violin; the status topic's line takes it and sets 100.
